content.title: Combining antiplatelets and OAC

recommendations.summary: Default strategy for patients with atrial fibrillation and CHA2DS2-VASc score ≥1 in men and ≥2 in women.
recommendations.detail: After up to 1 week of triple antithrombotic therapy following the ACS event, dual antithrombotic therapy using a NOAC at the recommended dose for stroke prevention plus a single oral antiplatelet agent (preferably clopidogrel) for up to 12 months is recommended.
During PCI, a UFH bolus is recommended in any of the following circumstances: if the patient is on a NOAC; if the INR is <2.5 in VKA-treated patients.

notes: CHA2DS2-VASc scoring thresholds specified (≥1 men, ≥2 women).
Preferred single antiplatelet agent named: clopidogrel.
NOACs and VKAs referenced with guidance on anticoagulation management during PCI and target INR threshold.
citations: References indicated (305–310) for the dual therapy recommendation.
